talking_points: Nvidia is quietly buying stakes in French AI startups as part of a planned €2bn European push, while chip-equipment maker ASML says customers are already booking orders for 2029 and 2030.
A brutal two-day sell-off in memory chip stocks shows how jittery investors have become about AI financing and Chinese competition, even as the underlying technology demand keeps growing.
OpenAI says it used its own AI models to catch an employee who allegedly planted a hidden recording device in an executive meeting room, and was arrested by the FBI.
